```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create a sample DataFrame
df_pd = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"],
    "spend": [1500, 800, 1000, 600]
})

# Convert to narwhals DataFrame
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)

# Add tier column using a conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Convert back to native if needed
result = nw.to_native(df)
print(result)
```
